item.text: {"decisions":[{"id":"removed-api-and-crash","verdict":"pass","reason":"Correctly ties the plugin's session.events reads to the non-iterable crash and cites removal in alpha.4 with seq, eventAt(), and snapshotEvents() as replacements."},{"id":"peer-check-boundary","verdict":"pass","reason":"Correctly explains that alpha.5 satisfies the declared peer semver range while npm checks metadata only, not API existence, behavior, or testing."},{"id":"distinct-breakage-categories","verdict":"pass","reason":"Identifies distinct runtime-failure classes including removed APIs, changed value shapes/types, and changed signatures or return contracts."},{"id":"author-prevention","verdict":"pass","reason":"Requires testing actual supported versions and gives compatible policies: narrow metadata ranges or migrate/guard with runtime capability handling; it correctly distinguishes metadata from runtime guards."},{"id":"user-preinstall-check","verdict":"pass","reason":"Provides a concrete tarball/source inspection and changelog/API comparison that would detect Session.events removal before installation."}],"caps":[{"id":"peers-prove-runtime","triggered":false,"reason":"The report explicitly states that peer-range satisfaction and warning-free installation do not prove runtime compatibility."}]}
